verdict.label: HOLD — BUY upgrade conditions unmet; Iran reverses Wednesday's catalyst
verdict.rationale_short: All three BUY upgrade conditions from the May 20 night brief have failed at Thursday's pre-market open: SPX futures at 7,422 (vs. 7,460 required), NVDA's AH recovery did not hold into pre-market with ES futures down -0.39%, and the 30Y at 5.12% has not begun the required two-session consecutive close below 5.05%. A new overnight catalyst compounds the caution: Iran's Supreme Leader issued a directive that near-weapons-grade uranium cannot leave the country, reversing the Middle East peace-deal narrative that drove Wednesday's 5% oil decline and Russell +2.44% rally. WTI stabilized back at ~$99, the inflation-relief impulse is partially withdrawn, and VIX is rising (+2.06% to 17.80) rather than retreating. HOLD: do not add new longs at the open; let NVDA resolve beats-and-drops before entering; maintain TBT hedge.

If the Iran situation escalates further (Strait of Hormuz risk re-priced, oil back above $103), the 30Y re-tests 5.20% and the NVDA-driven bid fails to hold. The SpaceX IPO ($75B raise, June 12) is now a confirmed capital allocation decision competing with every existing AI name over the next three weeks.
